ns2:section.sectionText: Frontiers in Physiology. This is a journal-club-based course offered in combination with the weekly Department of Molecular & Integrative Physiology Seminar where students read & discuss primary literature, attend visiting scientists’ seminars and participate in roundtable discussions of the speakers' research. This class will meet in B102 CLSL from 11-11:50 on Thursday and in B126 CLSL from 12:00-12:50 pm Thursday. Undergraduates may enroll with permission from the instructor. This course will NOT count as advanced MCB hours for MCB majors.
